badRange: Type a cell or range, like B2 or A1:D20
cellsChanged: {count, plural, one {# cell changed} other {# cells changed}}
clearMessage: The list of changes kept with this spreadsheet will be emptied for everyone who opens it. The cells themselves stay as they are, and saved versions are kept.
clearRange: Show changes anywhere on the sheet

countTo: {more, select, yes {{count, plural, one {# change shown, older ones below to {range}.} other {# changes shown, older ones below to {range}.}}} other {{count, plural, one {# change to {range}.} other {# changes to {range}.}}}}
countToOnSheet: {more, select, yes {{count, plural, one {# change shown, older ones below to {range} on this sheet.} other {# changes shown, older ones below to {range} on this sheet.}}} other {{count, plural, one {# change to {range} on this sheet.} other {# changes to {range} on this sheet.}}}}
everySheet: The range is looked for on every sheet

useSelectionTitle: Show the changes to the selected cells
